info.name: Convert PDF to JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP & GIF PDF To Image APIs API

params.name: format
params.description: Specifies the desired format for the API response. Choose 'json' for a JSON object or 'xml' for an XML structure.

params.name: file_id
params.description: The unique ID of a PDF file already uploaded to the API Freaks server. Use this as an alternative to uploading a new file directly.

params.name: destroy
params.description: If set to `true`, the input file(s) will be permanently deleted from the server immediately after the output PDF is generated.

params.name: output
params.description: The desired name for the output unrestricted PDF file. If not provided, a default name will be assigned.

params.name: pages
params.description: Specifies the pages or ranges at which to split the PDF. Accepts individual page numbers (e.g., '1') and/or page ranges (e.g., '4-2', 'last'). Ranges can be ascending or descending. Use commas to separate entries and hyphens for ranges. Alternatively, provide only one of the following keywords: 'even' (split at every even-numbered page), 'odd' (split at every odd-numbered page), 'last' (split at the last page only), or 'all' (split into single pages). Examples: '1,4-2,last', 'odd', 'all'. Mixing special keywords with specific pages/ranges is not allowed.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Specifies the resolution (in DPI) for the output images. Acceptable Range is from 20 to 1200.

params.name: image_smoothing
params.description: Determines the smoothing options to apply during image conversion. Valid values are 'none', 'all' or a combination of 'text', 'line', and 'image' (comma-separated).If not provided, no smoothing will be applied.

params.name: profile
params.description: Specifies the color profile for the output PNG images. Acceptable values: bw (1-bit black & white, smallest size, no grayscale or color), gray (8-bit grayscale), rgb (24-bit RGB color, default), rgba (32-bit RGB color with alpha channel for transparency), 4-bit (4-bit indexed color, up to 16 colors, smaller size), or 8-bit (8-bit indexed color, up to 256 colors).

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: The URL to which the webhook notification will be sent after the task is completed.

params.name: webhook_failure_notification
params.description: If true, a notification will also be sent by email in case the webhook request fails all the retries.  The email notification will be sent to the requesting user or their organization’s admin if part of one.

items.docs: This API converts a given PDF file into a sequence of PNG images.
